```{r setup, include = FALSE}
# Workplan Section IV (post-processing), at census-tract level.
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE,
                      fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4)
source(here::here("scripts", "00_setup.R"))
library(rstatix)
library(lme4)
library(performance)
library(ggplot2)
measures <- read_measures()
id_col   <- id_col_name(TARGET_TRACT_VINTAGE)   # "GEOID20"
label_of <- function(v) { l <- measures$label[match(v, measures$clean_var)]; ifelse(is.na(l), v, l) }
id_of    <- function(df) intersect(c("GEOID20", "GEOID10"), names(df))[1]
```

Geography: **census tracts (`r TARGET_TRACT_VINTAGE` vintage)** · merge key: **`r id_col`, year** · study years: **`r year_span(STUDY_YEARS)`**

# 1-2. Clean files imported

```{r import}
clean <- load_clean_all()   # every supp_*.RData in supplemental_clean
inventory <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(clean), function(nm) {
  df <- clean[[nm]]; id <- id_of(df)
  data.frame(file = nm, id_column = id, rows = nrow(df),
             tracts = dplyr::n_distinct(df[[id]]), years = year_span(df$year),
             measures = paste(setdiff(names(df), c(id, "year")), collapse = ", "),
             merged = id == id_col)
}))
knitr::kable(inventory)
```

# 3. Merge (all = TRUE)

```{r merge}
df_merged <- merge_clean(clean, id_col)
```

```{r merge-note, results = "asis"}
not_merged <- inventory$file[!inventory$merged]
if (length(not_merged)) {
  cat("Not merged because they are not on", TARGET_TRACT_VINTAGE, "tracts:",
      paste0("`", not_merged, "`", collapse = ", "),
      "(described separately below; see docs/decisions_log.md).\n\n")
}
```

# 4. Checks

```{r checks, results = "asis"}
if (is.null(df_merged)) {
  cat("No clean files on", id_col, "yet, so nothing was merged.\n")
} else {
  cat("**Unique tracts in merged data:**", sum(!is.na(unique(df_merged[[id_col]]))), "\n\n")
  cov <- county_tracts(TARGET_TRACT_VINTAGE)
  if (!is.null(cov)) cat("**Tracts in", COUNTY_NAME, "County (", TARGET_TRACT_VINTAGE, "):**", length(cov), "\n\n")

  tab <- table(df_merged[[id_col]], df_merged$year)
  cat("**Years of data per tract** (number of tracts with each count of years):\n\n")
  cat(knitr::kable(as.data.frame(table(years_per_tract = rowSums(tab > 0)), responseName = "tracts")), sep = "\n")
  cat("\n\n<details><summary>Full table: tract x year</summary>\n\n")
  cat(knitr::kable(as.data.frame.matrix(tab)), sep = "\n")
  cat("\n\n</details>\n\n")
}
```

# 5. Save merged dataset

```{r save}
if (!is.null(df_merged)) save_clean(df_merged, "supp_all_SDoW")
```

Saved to `data/supplemental_clean/supp_all_SDoW.csv` and `.RData`.

# 6. Descriptive statistics by measure

```{r describe-merged, results = "asis", fig.height = 4}
if (!is.null(df_merged)) {
  for (m in setdiff(names(df_merged), c(id_col, "year"))) {
    describe_measure(df_merged, m, id_col, label = label_of(m))
  }
}
```

```{r describe-unmerged, results = "asis", fig.height = 4}
if (length(not_merged)) {
  cat("\n\n## Measures not in the merged file\n\n")
  for (nm in not_merged) {
    df <- clean[[nm]]; id <- id_of(df)
    cat("\n\n**", nm, "** (", id, ")\n\n", sep = "")
    for (m in setdiff(names(df), c(id, "year"))) describe_measure(df, m, id, label = label_of(m))
  }
}
```
